list_discussions_repo: list discussions and pull requests on a Hugging Face Hub repo with optional status and kind filters
create_discussion_pr: create a new discussion or pull request on a Hugging Face Hub repo with a title and optional body
comment_on_discussion: add a comment to an existing discussion or pull request on a Hugging Face Hub repo
close_reopen_discussion: close or reopen a discussion or pull request on a Hugging Face Hub repo with an optional comment
merge_pull_request: merge a pull request on a Hugging Face Hub repo with an optional comment
